correctness.rationale: Direct expansion gives the exact endemic convolution linearization and characteristic determinant. Nonincreasing K gives convex F and each exponential tilt remains convex; a curvature-measure cosine-transform formula forces Re Fhat>=0 for Re z>=0. Combining this with strict comparison of the normalized nonnegative A transform gives Re Delta(z)>0 for every Re z>=0. Exponentially integrable F yields an analytic strip, uniform high-frequency decay, a zero-free left strip and a weighted causal convolution resolvent, so quadratic nonlinear remainder is a small contraction for incidence histories. Uniform-duration, gamma and hyperexponential cases meet the displayed hypotheses. Finite numerical checks only supplement the proof.

originality.rationale: The motivating complete manuscript gives the model and numerical Hopf scenarios at larger gamma shapes, but not the unrestricted-infectivity convex-survival no-Hopf theorem. A strong 2017 global-SIS result assumes constant age-infectivity; a classical 1982 Fourier result assumes deterministic return age. The new conclusion and their hypotheses are incomparable. Complete analysis of some related SIRS papers was unavailable, and an independent human novelty audit is pending.

value.rationale: In the same model where concentrated gamma recovery times permit numerical endemic Hopf bifurcations, this proves a rigorous unconditional shape regime excluding them for every possible nonnegative age-infectivity curve. It covers all gamma durations with shape at most one, mixed exponential durations and uniform durations, so the mechanism is convex survival rather than variance alone. It clarifies when approximation-induced or genuine Hopf switches are impossible, while avoiding claims of global dynamics or existence of cycles.
